bureau: Credit reporting agencies licensed by the Bank of Zambia
note: The Credit Reporting Act, 2018 (Act 8 of 2018, published 31 July 2018, commenced 17 October 2019 by the Commencement Order, 2019), in ZambiaLII's source PDF read from archive.org's snapshot of 5 November 2025 (zambialii.org itself answers with a Cloudflare check; ZambiaLII's page, in a snapshot of 14 May 2026, lists no amending act, only the commencement). Section 29(e): a credit reporting agency shall not include in a credit report information on a debt three years after the debt's final payment or, if no payment is made, five years after the person incurred it. The game reads this as a late payment shown five years while unpaid (keep 5; the Act counts from when the debt was incurred, the game from the late payment) and lifting three years after it is paid, written as 1096 days (three years of 365.25 days). No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the next monthly update. On 2026-11-03 zambialii.org answered with a Cloudflare check and archive.org didn't answer, so the snapshots keep their reading of 2026-10-30; the Act as gazetted (the publication document in Laws.Africa's Legislation Commons, the platform ZambiaLII publishes from) and the Commons' version of 31 July 2018, which gives the commencement, were read that day and still say what is quoted. Until 2026-11-03 ZambiaLII's source PDF and page and Laws.Africa's consolidated version were cited as primary; they are a legal information institute's copy of the law, so secondary since the ruling of 2026-11-03, so they were relabelled, naming the Act's gazetted text (Laws.Africa's scan of the gazette's pages, still primary, read again that day: s. 29(e) as quoted). The commencement of 17 October 2019 rests on those copies; the Commencement Order wasn't reached.
